notes.title: May bug fixes
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] re-enabled track selector; press trigger button to cycle through available tracks
[*] added a brake button as the alternative method to reverse the buggy
[*] the coffee table is now available as teleportation target in some tracks
[*] tweaked the lap penalty mechanics
[*] added 1 new track and 1 new part (no. 28)
[/olist]

notes.title: 2020 update
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] updated game to latest SteamVR to support index controllers
[*] snap turn is now available
[*] added RC transmitter
[*] added a lobby UI to multiplayer mode (requires right hand controller to point-and-click)
[/olist]

notes.title: August Update 2
notes.notes:
- added a new track
- fix an issue where the player buggy's indicator triangle wobbles strangely
- adjust the snap distance threshold for attaching wheels

notes.title: End of June Update
notes.notes:
[list]
    [*] added an indicator to distinguish player's racer from CPU racers
    [*] added the ability to select tracks
    [*] added the ability to reset a race during any time by pressing menu button
    [*] updated the laptop to clarify the intended functionality
    [*] adjusted the texture for one of the bodies
[/list]
